question.text: An unknown compound A <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>8</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> on acetylation with <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mo>/</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi></math> forms acetyl derivative of A whose MW is 280. A on treat with <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> gives methyl ether of B having MW 182. If the number of phenolic hydroxyls and alcoholic hydroxyls in the compound A are X and Y respectively. Find the sum of X + Y here?

solution.text:
Number of hydroxyl group by acetylation method =  280−MW of  C 8 H 10 O 3 42
=280-15442=12642=3
Number of phenolic hydroxyl =  MW of methyl ether−MW 14
=182-15414=2814=2
Hence, X = 2
Number of alcoholic -OH groups =3-2=1
Hence, Y = 1
So X + Y = 2 + 1 = 3.
